title: Codentry evaluation case
description: One pull-request-shaped change (base -> head) plus the defects known to have been introduced by it. Ground truth is established by construction, executable tests, dataset annotation or independent human review -- never by a model (see docs/research-design.md). With ground_truth_status `labeled`, `ground_truth` lists the defects the change introduces (it may be empty: a clean change); with `unlabeled` nobody has labeled the change, `ground_truth` must be empty, and recall/precision are undefined for it.

ground_truth_status.description: `labeled`: ground_truth is the defect list for this change, so an unmatched finding is a candidate false positive (still to be adjudicated). `unlabeled`: no defect labels exist (e.g. noise-measurement pull requests); findings count only toward volume/noise measures.

id.description: Must equal the case directory name.

stratum.description: Reporting group. Strata are always reported separately, never pooled (e.g. mutant:logic vs mutant:rule-aligned). Harness self-test data uses the fixture: prefix and is not evidence.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the redistributed code, or a LicenseRef-* label for project-authored material.

derivation.description: `pull_request`: base/head are a merged pull request's parent and merge result. `reversed_fix`: base is a bug's FIXED revision and head its BUGGY revision, so the change reintroduces the bug (not a natural pull request).

oneOf.description: Produced by a deterministic generator (e.g. a mutation operator); regenerating from the seed must reproduce the case byte for byte.

origin.description: The real file the generator started from.

oneOf.description: Written by hand by a named author (harness fixtures).

files.description: The changed files. `path` is the path at the head (the identity path); `base`/`head` are file locations relative to the case directory.

ground_truth.description: Defects introduced by the change, located on HEAD lines.

provenance.description: How the defect came to exist / was found.

verified_by.description: How the label was confirmed. A model is deliberately not an allowed method: ground truth is never a model judging a model.

group.description: Locations of ONE defect share a group (e.g. a bug whose fix touched several hunks). Recall counts a group once, detected if any of its locations is hit. Absent = the entry is its own defect.

equivalence.description: Mutation-seeded defects only: whether the mutant is known to change behavior. `unchecked` means nobody has shown it is not semantically equivalent to the original, so some of these 'defects' may not be defects.
